programme.title: Wild New Zealand | S01E01
programme.desc: A three-episode documentary revealing the secrets of the flora and fauna of the remote islands of New Zealand, the last land discovered and inhabited by humans. For 80 million years, life went on there in its own strange way. With the arrival of people, new species of animals arrived there, such as merino, ermine, and kakapo, the only flightless species of parrot in the world, found only there. In New Zealand forests you can track down predators from the Jurassic period, meet forest penguins and sheep dogs flying in helicopters. Great Britain. 2016. documentary film

programme.title: Wild New Zealand | S01E02
programme.desc: A three-episode documentary revealing the secrets of the flora and fauna of the remote islands of New Zealand, the last land discovered and inhabited by humans. For 80 million years, life went on there in its own strange way. With the arrival of people, new species of animals arrived there, such as merino, ermine, and kakapo, the only flightless species of parrot in the world, found only there. In the far corner of the Pacific Ocean lies New Zealand, cut off from the rest of the world since the time of the dinosaurs. Fauna and flora developed here in a unique way. In this lost world, nature has special rules: penguins in the forest, parrots in the snow and predators as if taken straight from prehistoric times. Representatives of flora and fauna must struggle with the geological forces that have provided the beauty of this land. Here you can meet pioneers conquering mountain peaks, dolphins emerging from the depths of the sea, and birds hunting with masterful agility over hot streams. Great Britain. 2016. documentary film

programme.title: Ice Age: Frozen World | E03
programme.desc: Naturalist and explorer Steve Backshall and wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan take viewers on a gripping journey into the heart of the Ice Age. Using stunning outdoor photography from around the world and interviews with experts, they chronicle the rise of prehistoric megabeasts, from woolly mammoths to saber-toothed cats. They also present the history of the fight between Neanderthals and Homo sapiens. They will discover the secrets of the era that created the world we live in. It turns out that another extreme temperature drop on Earth may be caused by... climate change and global warming. With the melting of ice and global warming, a completely new era in Earth's history begins. Steve Backshall and Michaela Strachan set out to search for the land that connected Britain with the Old Continent before the end of the Ice Age. Steve goes deep beneath the waves, and Michaela investigates the course of the natural disaster that formed the North Sea and divided Europe. The disaster was a catalyst for the further development of the first people who began to create boats. In the Arctic, Michaela works with the British Antarctic Survey drilling for ice cores. The material obtained in this way will reveal how the world's climate is changing. It turns out that global warming may create ideal conditions for the start of a new ice age. Steve will test whether people would cope if the Earth were plunged into eternal frost again. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Planet of Sharks – In extreme conditions | S01E03
programme.desc: Scientists use modern technologies to monitor the underwater life of various species of sharks. These cartilaginous fish are completely unjustifiably associated with bloodthirsty predators. They hunt intelligently, using their keen senses and developed hunting instincts. Viewers will see, among others: how a whitetip shark senses the heartbeat of its prey. Sharks, which appeared on Earth before dinosaurs, have adapted to life even in the most unfavorable environments. Scientists are investigating the secret of their evolutionary success. USA. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Monsters from the depths | E01
programme.desc: Steve Backshall will show viewers the world of giants located in the depths of the sea. Thanks to the help of experts and biologists, they will learn more about the giant squid, anglerfish, megalodon, and other fascinating animal species. The presenter will present creatures inhabiting the depths of the sea and their behavior. He will present, among others: anglerfish and black snailfish, which can be found at depths of 500-3800 m below sea level. Great Britain. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Gladiators of the Animal World – River in the Jungle | E03
programme.desc: Some animals have a predisposition to fighting and facing enemies. With deadly weapons, cunning and tactics, they are born warriors of this world. The dense tropical jungle in America is teeming with life. It is inhabited by, among others, poisonous frogs, jaguars and stingrays - the gladiators of the animal kingdom. Australia. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Highlands | E01
programme.desc: The Scottish Highlands are dominated by rocky hills and valleys. Climate change and humans have caused many changes in the region. Despite this, many wild animals still live here. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Islands | E02
programme.desc: Scotland's picturesque coastline is filled with hundreds of islands. Residents learned to live in harmony with wild animals and protect the surrounding waters from pollution. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Scotland – Lowlands | E03
programme.desc: Over 80% of Scotland's population lives in lowland areas. Wildlife used to be confined to these areas, but now animals can even appear in cities. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Scandinavia – In the light | E01
programme.desc: Scandinavia is one of the places in the world where there is a polar night and a polar day. This is accompanied by months of darkness, and then the sun returns to the sky. There is also Midsommar, which is a gradual shortening of the day until the next night. Winter in Scandinavia is marked by the arrival of the polar night. This is a period when the sun does not rise for a long period of time. Animals, plants and people who have to adapt to extreme conditions will be presented. Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Kielder Forests – Spring | E01
programme.desc: Kielder Forest is the largest forest in England. The creators decided to take a closer look at the animals living there. We will learn how they adapt to the changing seasons. Some of them decide to stay there during this process, and some leave it for the winter... Great Britain. 2021. documentary series

programme.title: African predators: the big four – Leopards | E02
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: In Search of Rain | E02
programme.desc: A herd of elephants faces a challenge when the river dries up due to lack of rain. Phoenix, the leader of a pack of wild dogs, is fighting against time: she has to feed five puppies. In the dry riverbed, elephants are trying to dig holes. Culet, a female cheetah and recently also a mother, is looking for prey. To do this, he ventures into the lions' territory. Phoenix is ​​in trouble because of the hyenas. Canada. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Leopard, sand and heat | E02
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Leopards live in thousands of ecosystems, from the rainforests of India to the driest regions of Africa; they adapt to almost any climate, feeding on over 100 different species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.desc: Namibia is a country of endless deserts and unique landscapes, from the Namib and Kalahari deserts to the savannah in the northeast. Life in desert areas is not easy. Its landscape has not changed for over 55 million years. It is one of the most beautiful deserts in Africa. South Africa. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Phi Slama Jama
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Dynasty. Korostelev-Morilov
programme.desc: The series about the three-hundred-year history of the Romanov dynasty in Russia is designed for the widest audience, but the time frame of the events described is somewhat wider than the reign of the Romanov dynasty. The geography of the series is also very extensive. In addition to Moscow, the authors visited Vladimir, Uglich, Kostroma, St. Petersburg and its environs. The Belarusian Mogilev, which for two years was practically the third capital of Russia for two years, was not ignored. In addition, the seaside cities of Azov, Taganrog and Livadia were not forgotten. The film uses rare footage of the Valaam archipelago, where Alexander I made a pilgrimage, asking for blessings for his feat. The main task of the authors of the series can be considered that they tried to tell the audience a three-hundred-year history popularly and vividly, without archival dust. Director: Alexey Pishchulin. Cast: Andrey Smirnov, Andrey Bogdanov, Denis Solodovnikov, Sergey Nilov, Nina Sorotokina, Evgeny Anisimov. Russia, 2013, biography

programme.title: Our forests
programme.desc: Forests are much more than just a collection of beech or fir trees. They form a kind of superorganism whose parts are closely and diversely interconnected: roots and fungal threads run through the soil like a network of nerves. Forest air is permeated with chemical messages that trees exchange with each other. Researchers are only gradually beginning to decipher them.

programme.title: Our forests
programme.desc: It's not just the color of the leaves that changes: each season places its own demands on the forest and its inhabitants. Animations show how they survive between abundance and scarcity.

programme.title: Our forests
programme.desc: Last episode. Forests are powerful reservoirs of fresh water and store valuable water for times of drought. This is the only way photosynthesis, which is important for us, works. An old beech tree produces oxygen for around 50 people. – What makes trees our allies in the fight against climate change.

programme.title: Survival on the Amazon
programme.desc: There is always something moving in the Amazon. A jaguar sneaks towards the river, the snake dares to attack and a tarantula lies in wait for its prey. When hunting, the predators are unpredictable. (Station info).

programme.title: Survival on the Amazon
programme.desc: How challenging is finding a partner in the jungle? From monogamous monkeys to courtship-loving birds and spiders who even risk their lives to reproduce. (Station info).

programme.title: Survival on the Amazon
programme.desc: The Amazon is one of the most biodiverse habitats on earth. Around 1,200 species of animals populate the dense treetops and branched branches. A place that forces animals to make new adaptations. (Station info).

programme.title: Survival on the Amazon
programme.desc: In times of water scarcity and limited living space, animals are forced to develop new survival strategies. Those who fail to do this often quickly fall victim to predators. (Station info).

programme.title: Survival on the Amazon
programme.desc: Over 200,000 monkeys are traded illegally in Peru every year. Babies who were taken from their mothers are often affected. How do these orphaned animals learn to survive on their own in the wild? (Station info).

programme.title: Fantastic mushrooms – the magical world at our feet
programme.desc: They have a healing effect and keep entire ecosystems intact: Can mushrooms use their superpowers to help us overcome some of the greatest challenges of our time? (Station info).

programme.title: Forest of wild ponies
programme.desc: The New Forest National Park in southern England features moss-covered moors, ancient woodlands and lush heathland. Herds of deer and ponies roam freely in it. How are the animals there? (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Ibis has not produced any offspring for eight years. A larger living space is said to motivate the Asiatic lion. After the freshwater vampire crabs reach sexual maturity, disaster occurs in the tank. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Nothing will come of the Bongos' offspring. Safi and Moti shy away from each other. And the team faces a challenge when they have to collect blood from two Sunda gavial crocodiles. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The female chimpanzees Vila and Alice fight for dominance in the group. The zookeepers are waiting anxiously to see whether a pair of Chinese crocodile-tailed lizards will finally have offspring. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: A Moellendorff's climbing snake meets male Jakob. Will there be babies or will she eat her lover? The zookeepers are trying to care for a sick Rothschild giraffe, Dagmar. (Station info).

programme.title: The waterhole - Africa's wildlife oasis
programme.desc: Heavy rain brings rich pasture areas around the waterhole. Biologist Ella Al-Shamahi is studying what effects this has on herbivores and predators. (Station info).

programme.title: The largest animals on earth
programme.desc: Whether for entire species or individual creatures – size plays an important role in the animal kingdom. The bigger, the better the chances of defending yourself against predators and finding food. (Station info).

programme.title: The great migrations of animals
programme.desc: Thousands of zebras migrate across Africa to feast on the rich grass of Nxai Pan National Park. For the first time, scientists accompany them the entire way. (Station info).

programme.title: Fascination Africa
programme.desc: In the east of Botswana is the Mashatu Reserve, also called the “Land of the Giants”. Here, in addition to the impressive wildlife, you can find huge baobabs that grow along the rivers. (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: After a territorial fight, the male lions disappear, leaving the pride unprotected. A leopard risks everything for love and a young cheetah steps out of its mother's shadow. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild dogs: hunters between worlds
programme.desc: The secrets of canid success: their survival in extreme regions, their family structures and their amazing methods of foraging. (Station info).

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: At around 3,000 km long, the Danube (Gorge of the Iron Gates) is only the second longest river in Europe, but it is the most international in the world: it flows through ten countries and four capitals, Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest and Belgrade. The Danube is less a border river than a transport artery connecting peoples. The Danube is also important as a fascinating natural paradise that is home to over 2,000 animal and plant species.

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: Three rivers, three continents: habitats and stories from the Yukon, the Danube and the Zambezi. The start is from Canada to Alaska, where the 3120 km long Yukon makes its way until it flows into the Bering Sea. When the huge river freezes over completely in winter, it becomes a legendary ice highway through the untouched nature of North America. The wildlife along the river is also fascinating: whether grizzlies, huge herds of reindeer, massive elk, lynx or agile salmon - many unique animal species can be found around or in the river. \n\nSince temperatures down to minus 50 degrees are not uncommon in winter, only a few people live along the Yukon. In a few smaller towns and remote settlements, people are defying the harsh conditions. In some cases the settlements can only be reached via the river.

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: Patagonia's extreme nature poses great challenges for the animals. Condors, pumas, flamingos and rare rodents have to cope with polar winds, ice fields and deserts. (Station info).

programme.title: Eden on Earth – The Last Paradise
programme.desc: In Alaska's wilderness between dark winter and short summer, grizzlies, moose, eagles and whales fight for survival. At the same time, climate change and pollution threaten the fragile ecosystem. (Station info).

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP04
programme.desc: Lauro săn tuần lộc trong điều kiện mất điện ở North Slope của Alaska; Bret và Ivy, bị chôn vùi dưới lớp tuyết dày đặc, cố gắng thiết lập đường bẫy dài 230 dặm của họ; Daniel phóng từ cabin nổi của mình để săn hươu.

programme.title: FORGED IN FIRE S10 EP08

programme.title: THE TOYS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP09
programme.desc: Từ Xe lửa Lionel đến trò chơi điện tử, đối với người sưu tập phù hợp, đồ chơi thời thơ ấu của chúng ta có thể trị giá hàng triệu USD! Trong những thập kỷ qua, mọi người đã phải trả một số mức giá thực sự quá đắt cho những món đồ chơi mà họ hằng mong muốn.

programme.title: THE TOYS THAT BUILT THE WORLD S3 EP10
programme.desc: Trong sáu thập kỷ, hai doanh nhân ngớ ngẩn nhưng hiểu biết-S.S. Adams và H. Fishlove đã biến sở thích đùa vui của họ thành ngành công nghiệp đồ chơi chơi khăm đang bùng nổ. Sự cạnh tranh của họ đã tạo ra hàng trăm mánh khóe và trò đùa.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP01

programme.title: ANH HÙNG PHƯƠNG THẾ NGỌC - FONG SAI-YUK, RETURN OF HEROES

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của Bác Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: BẠN CÓ ĐỦ BẢN LĨNH? - RUTE:TOUGHNESS REDEFINED
programme.desc: Cuộc thi khu vực ngày càng tăng R U Tough Enough đang tìm kiếm người cứng rắn nhất đến từ Đông Nam Á. Tham gia tìm kiếm và gặp gỡ một số cá nhân mạnh mẽ nhất về tinh thần và thể chất, dẫn đến trận đấu cuối cùng hoành tráng tại Kuala Lumpur với giải thưởng trị giá 15.000 USD!

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: NA TRA: ĐƯỜNG ĐUA RỰC LỬA - NEZHA
programme.desc: Một cựu tay đua hàng đầu muốn chứng tỏ bản thân trong một cuộc đua nhưng lại vô tình làm tổn thương đồng đội Lily, dẫn đến sự sụp đổ của đội. Khi một nhà vô địch đua xe ảo thiếu kinh nghiệm gia nhập đội và bất ngờ tỏa sáng trong một cuộc đua ngoài đời thực, liệu ba tay đua có thể hợp tác để giành lại vinh quang cho đội của mình?

programme.title: ANH HÙNG PHƯƠNG THẾ NGỌC - FONG SAI-YUK, RETURN OF HEROES
programme.desc: Sau khi cha nuôi của Fong Sai-Yuk bị sát hại bởi những kẻ phản bội của Hội Hoa Đỏ, anh thề sẽ săn lùng họ và trả thù cho cái chết của ông. Bị thúc đẩy bởi nỗi đau và lòng trung thành, anh đứng lên chống lại những kẻ âm mưu trong một cuộc chiến tàn nhẫn vì công lý.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: TRUY TÌM BÍ DANH SỐ 0 - THE COMEBACK
programme.desc: Chú Hứa là một đặc vụ đã nghỉ hưu, chủ một cửa hàng đồ cổ trên phố cổ. Khi con phố cũ bị Green Dragon Gang địa phương buộc phải phá bỏ, danh tính ẩn giấu của Bác Hua vô tình bị tiết lộ và ông bị truy đuổi bởi một tổ chức bí ẩn do Ah Jie đứng đầu. Một cuộc đấu tay đôi chí mạng vừa mới bắt đầu!

programme.title: BẠN CÓ ĐỦ BẢN LĨNH? - RUTE:TOUGHNESS REDEFINED
programme.desc: Cuộc thi khu vực ngày càng tăng R U Tough Enough đang tìm kiếm người cứng rắn nhất đến từ Đông Nam Á. Tham gia tìm kiếm và gặp gỡ một số cá nhân mạnh mẽ nhất về tinh thần và thể chất, dẫn đến trận đấu cuối cùng hoành tráng tại Kuala Lumpur với giải thưởng trị giá 15.000 USD!

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!
